document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

text: The bar chart compares the number of visitors, in thousands, who went to the City Museum and the Science Centre in the first six months of the year.

Overall, the City Museum's visitor numbers more than doubled and overtook those of the Science Centre, whose figures stayed within a narrow range. The two museums therefore showed very different patterns over the six months.

The Science Centre attracted more visitors than the City Museum in the first four months. Its figure rose gradually from 55,000 in January to a peak of 64,000 in April, and then fell slightly to 61,000 in June. The differences between the two museums were small in March, at only 17,000 visitors.

The City Museum began with only 42,000 visitors and dipped to 38,000 in February. After that, the number climbed sharply, reaching 60,000 in April and 90,000 in June, which was 29,000 more than the Science Centre. In May, it had already passed its rival, with 78,000 against 63,000. Visitor numbers at the City Museum were more than twice as high in June as in February.
